title: Audit Trail: Compare and Restore Content Versions | Orchard Core
description:
A content item is edited by mistake, or deleted by accident, and you need the earlier text back.

The Audit Trail module keeps a copy of a content item with each recorded event. You open that copy, compare it with the previous one, and restore an earlier version, or a deleted item, as a draft.

In this video:
• How the Audit Trail keeps versions, and what limits them
• Choosing the content types to record
• Finding the history of a content item
• Viewing an earlier version
• Comparing two versions
• Restoring an earlier version
• Restoring a deleted item
